composicao: one iconic, centered scene with the city's main landmark large and clear, and one or two smaller secondary landmarks or symbols in the background, in the upper 80% of the card

itens.elementos: Sugarloaf Mountain, a tall rounded granite dome rising from the blue water of Guanabara Bay, with a thin cable line and a small cable car gondola running to its top; in the background: the curved black-and-white wave-pattern sidewalk of Copacabana beach with a few palm trees; one single green peak behind, with one single tiny pale statue with open arms on its top

the MASP museum: a long, low, horizontal dark glass box, about four times wider than tall, held high above the ground by two giant red concrete frames, one at each end; each red frame is rectangular with sharp square corners, two straight vertical red pillars joined at the top by a straight thick horizontal red beam; the glass box hangs between the two frames, just below their red top beams, with an empty open plaza underneath; in the background: a dense skyline of towers including the Altino Arantes (Banespa) tower with its spire; yellow and pink ipê trees in bloom

the Pelourinho historic square: a steep cobblestone street lined with two-story colonial houses painted in bright blue, yellow, pink and green, with a blue baroque church with two white bell towers at the top of the slope; in the background: a berimbau musical bow leaning against a wall in the foreground; a glimpse of the blue bay behind

the National Congress: two slim twin towers between a downturned dome and an upturned bowl, with a reflecting pool; in the background: the crown-shaped Cathedral of Brasília with white curved columns; red earth under a wide open sky

the Botanical Garden greenhouse: a white iron-and-glass greenhouse with a central dome and two lower side wings, with a geometric French flower garden in front; in the background: two or three araucaria pine trees with their candelabra-shaped crowns

the Amazon Theatre: a pink neoclassical facade crowned by a dome of green, yellow and blue tiles; in the background: the Meeting of the Waters, a dark river and a sandy river flowing side by side; the edge of the rainforest

the colorful two-story colonial facades of Rua do Bom Jesus in old Recife; in the background: one small full-body frevo dancer holding up a tiny frevo umbrella with yellow, red, green and blue segments; one low bridge over the Capibaribe river behind

the Hercílio Luz bridge: a long white-gray steel suspension bridge with two tall slender steel towers; between the towers, instead of thin cables, a thick rigid steel lattice truss curves down from each tower top and meets the road deck at the center, forming a long lens shape; in the background: calm blue bay water; low, gently rounded green hills of the island

the Usina do Gasômetro: a red-brick power-plant building with one very tall brick chimney on the shore of Guaíba lake; in the background: a chimarrão gourd with a metal straw in the foreground; a purple-flowering jacarandá tree

the Devil's Throat of Iguaçu Falls seen from above: a wide U-shaped, horseshoe-shaped chasm where dozens of separate waterfalls pour side by side all around its rim, with thick white mist rising and a soft rainbow; in the background: lush green jungle along the rim; a thin wooden walkway over the water
a white baroque church with two round bell towers on top of a hill; in the background: a steep cobblestone street of white colonial houses with blue and yellow window frames; misty green mountains

a jangada fishing raft: a completely flat rectangular wooden platform of logs tied side by side, like a floating wooden deck with no hull and no raised sides, sitting flat on the green-turquoise sea, with one tall white triangular sail on a single mast; in the background: a few coconut palms and soft white sand dunes on the shore
the Ver-o-Peso market: a blue-gray iron building with four small pointed corner turrets on the riverbank; in the background: colorful wooden river boats; a woven basket of dark purple açaí berries
the Pampulha church: a row of wavy white modernist concrete vaults with a blue-and-white tile panel; in the background: the calm Pampulha lagoon; the Serra do Curral mountains on the horizon
a half-timbered Bavarian-style house with a steep dark roof; in the background: clusters of blue hydrangeas; tall dark-green pine trees
white colonial houses with brightly colored doors and window frames along an irregular stone street; in the background: small colorful wooden fishing boats; green mountains over the bay
high golden sand dunes with one small beach buggy driving over them; in the background: the star-shaped stone Forte dos Reis Magos at the edge of the sea
the green copper Statue of Liberty holding up her torch; in the background: the Manhattan skyline with the Empire State Building; the Brooklyn Bridge
the red-orange Golden Gate Bridge with light morning fog; in the background: one small cable car climbing a steep street; Victorian pastel houses
the white Griffith Observatory with its three domes on a dry golden hill; in the background: a row of very tall slender palm trees; the Santa Monica pier Ferris wheel in the distance

the Las Vegas Strip in daylight: a row of tall curved glittering resort hotel towers in the desert, their facades and rooftops completely blank and plain, with a long lake of tall dancing water fountains in front; in the background: the slender Strat tower with a round observation pod on top; bare reddish desert mountains on the horizon

the Cloud Gate sculpture: a giant, smooth, seamless, mirror-polished silver sculpture shaped like a kidney bean lying flat and horizontal directly on the plaza floor, much wider than tall, like a huge drop of mercury, with a low arched opening underneath, reflecting the sky and the skyline; in the background: the black Willis Tower, a boxy skyscraper made of stacked rectangular blocks of different heights with two white antennas on top; the blue water of Lake Michigan
the white dome of the United States Capitol; in the background: the tall white Washington Monument obelisk; pink cherry blossom trees
pastel art deco hotels on Ocean Drive with rounded corners and horizontal stripes; in the background: a colorful wooden lifeguard tower on the white beach; a few palm trees
a French Quarter townhouse with ornate wrought-iron lace balconies and hanging ferns; in the background: one green vintage streetcar; a small brass jazz trumpet
the slender CN Tower rising above the skyline on Lake Ontario; in the background: a few red maple leaves floating in the foreground
the Château Frontenac castle hotel with green copper roofs above the St. Lawrence river; in the background: an old stone street with a light dusting of snow
the Palacio de Bellas Artes: white marble palace with an orange and gold dome; in the background: one colorful trajinera boat of Xochimilco; strings of plain colorful papel picado banners
a pastel 1950s classic convertible car driving along the Malecón seawall; in the background: colorful crumbling colonial facades; the Capitolio dome in the distance
the white Obelisco in the middle of a very wide avenue; in the background: the colorful corrugated-tin houses of Caminito in La Boca; one small full-body tango couple
the snowy peaks of the Andes rising behind the city skyline with the tall Gran Torre Santiago; in the background: the white Virgin Mary statue on top of San Cristóbal hill
the yellow colonial buildings of the Plaza de Armas with carved dark wooden balconies and the cathedral; in the background: the cliffs of Miraflores over the Pacific with one small paraglider
a wall of perfectly fitted large Inca stones in a narrow street; in the background: the colonial cathedral of the Plaza de Armas; one llama with a colorful woven blanket

colorful colonial houses with wooden balconies covered in pink bougainvillea; in the background: the thick old stone city walls; one small full-body palenquera fruit seller with a bowl of fruit on her head
the tall ornate Palacio Salvo tower; in the background: the long seaside rambla promenade by the wide river; a mate gourd with a metal straw
the Eiffel Tower; in the background: the Seine river with an old stone bridge; a small café table with two bistro chairs
the Big Ben clock tower and the Houses of Parliament; in the background: a red double-decker bus; a red telephone box
the Colosseum; in the background: umbrella pine trees; a small pastel Vespa scooter
the white stone Rialto Bridge over the Grand Canal; in the background: two black gondolas with a gondolier in a striped shirt
the terracotta brick dome of the Florence Cathedral with Giotto's bell tower; in the background: the Ponte Vecchio over the Arno; tall Tuscan cypress trees
the white marble Leaning Tower of Pisa, clearly leaning; in the background: the white marble cathedral beside it; a bright green lawn
the tall spires of the Sagrada Família basilica; in the background: the colorful mosaic lizard of Park Güell in the foreground
the Cibeles fountain: a goddess on a chariot pulled by two lions; in the background: the Puerta de Alcalá triumphal gate in the background
the Plaza de España: a curved brick palace with two towers, a canal and tiled bridges; in the background: one small full-body flamenco dancer in a red dress; an orange tree
a yellow vintage tram climbing a steep narrow street; in the background: a facade of blue-and-white azulejo tiles; the Belém Tower small in the distance
the Dom Luís I iron arch bridge over the Douro river; in the background: the colorful stacked houses of Ribeira; two wooden rabelo boats
narrow tall canal houses with stepped and bell-shaped gables along a canal; in the background: bicycles leaning on a small arched bridge; red and yellow tulips
the Brandenburg Gate with the quadriga on top; in the background: the Berlin TV tower with its round sphere in the background
the two brick towers of the Frauenkirche with green onion-shaped domes; in the background: a giant pretzel in the foreground
St. Stephen's Cathedral with its tall gothic spire and colorful zigzag tiled roof; in the background: the Prater giant Ferris wheel in the distance
the Charles Bridge with its stone statues and gothic tower over the Vltava river; in the background: Prague Castle on the hill behind
the Hungarian Parliament building with its red dome on the bank of the Danube; in the background: the Chain Bridge
the Atomium: nine large silver spheres connected by tubes; in the background: a gilded guild-house facade of the Grand Place; a Belgian waffle
the Grossmünster church with its two towers on the bank of the river; in the background: snowy Alps on the horizon over the lake
the colorful gabled houses of Nyhavn along the canal; in the background: old wooden sailing boats moored in the canal

Stockholm City Hall: a long red-brick building on the waterfront with one tall square red-brick tower topped by a green-gold spire with three small golden crowns; in the background: the blue water of the lake with small white boats; the tall colorful houses of Gamla Stan across the water

the Holmenkollen ski jump: a giant, long, curved white steel ski-jump ramp rising high above a forested hill, its inrun sloping steeply down to a wide landing slope; in the background: the blue Oslofjord far below with small islands; a small Viking longship with a dragon head on the water
the white cast-iron Ha'penny Bridge over the Liffey river; in the background: a row of colorful Georgian doors; a green shamrock
Edinburgh Castle on top of a dark volcanic rock; in the background: one small full-body bagpiper in a tartan kilt; a purple thistle
the Parthenon on top of the Acropolis hill; in the background: an olive branch in the foreground
white cubic houses with blue domes on the cliff above the Aegean Sea; in the background: pink bougainvillea
the Blue Mosque with its domes and slender minarets; in the background: a ferry on the Bosphorus; colorful mosaic lamps
St. Basil's Cathedral with its colorful striped onion domes; in the background: the red Kremlin wall with a tower
the walled old town with orange roofs on the blue Adriatic; in the background: stone fortress walls; a few small sailboats
the Hallgrímskirkja church with its stepped concrete tower; in the background: small colorful houses with tin roofs; a snowy mountain across the bay
the Promenade des Anglais with a row of blue chairs facing the turquoise Bay of Angels; in the background: palm trees; a pebble beach
white yachts in the harbor below the cliffside Prince's Palace; in the background: the belle époque Monte Carlo casino building; the Mediterranean
the pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx; in the background: one camel; a white-sailed felucca on the Nile
the tall Koutoubia minaret; in the background: hanging pierced metal lanterns; a terracotta tagine pot; a touch of Majorelle blue
the flat-topped Table Mountain above the city and the sea; in the background: the bright colorful houses of Bo-Kaap; two small African penguins
a tall giraffe in the golden savanna with the city skyline far behind; in the background: flat-topped acacia trees
a wooden dhow sailboat with a triangular sail on turquoise water; in the background: an ornately carved wooden door of Stone Town

the Dome of the Rock: an octagonal building with walls covered in blue and turquoise tiles under a large shining golden dome topped by a small simple golden finial; in the background: the ancient pale stone walls of the Old City; olive trees
the very tall needle-shaped Burj Khalifa; in the background: the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab; soft desert dunes
the red-and-white Tokyo Tower; in the background: Mount Fuji with snow in the distance; pink cherry blossoms
the golden pavilion Kinkaku-ji reflected on its pond; in the background: a short row of red torii gates; red maple leaves
Osaka Castle: white walls, green roofs and gold details on a high stone base; in the background: the moat and pink cherry trees
a friendly spotted sika deer bowing; in the background: the giant wooden Todai-ji temple hall behind; a stone lantern
a gate of Gyeongbokgung palace with colorful painted eaves; in the background: N Seoul Tower on the green mountain behind

the Temple of Heaven: a perfectly round, circular wooden temple hall with three stacked circular conical roofs of dark blue glazed tiles, getting smaller toward the top, crowned by a small golden ball, standing on a round three-level white marble terrace; in the background: the Great Wall winding over green hills in the distance
the Oriental Pearl Tower with its pink spheres; in the background: the Huangpu river with boats; the colonial buildings of the Bund
a traditional junk boat with red sails in Victoria Harbour; in the background: the dense skyline under green hills

the Taipei 101 skyscraper: a very tall green-glass tower made of eight identical stacked segments, each segment slightly flaring outward toward its top like sections of bamboo, with a thin spire on top; in the background: a few plain red paper lanterns; green mountains behind the city
the tall spires of Wat Arun temple on the river; in the background: a floating market boat full of tropical fruit
Marina Bay Sands: three towers joined by a ship-shaped rooftop; in the background: the white Merlion fountain; the Supertree Grove
the silver Petronas Twin Towers joined by a skybridge; in the background: tropical palm trees
the small Turtle Tower on Hoan Kiem lake; in the background: a conical leaf hat; colorful silk lanterns
bright green rice terraces; in the background: a split stone temple gate; white frangipani flowers
the towers of Angkor Wat reflected in a pond; in the background: pink lotus flowers
rows of terracotta warrior statues; in the background: the ancient city wall with a bell tower behind
the Gateway of India stone arch by the sea; in the background: a black-and-yellow taxi
the white marble Taj Mahal with its long reflecting pool; in the background: rows of cypress trees
the pink honeycomb facade of the Hawa Mahal palace; in the background: a decorated elephant
stone ghat steps descending into the Ganges river in soft morning light; in the background: wooden boats; small floating marigold candle lamps
the white Boudhanath stupa with painted eyes on its golden tower; in the background: strings of plain colorful prayer flags; Himalayan peaks
the white sail-shaped shells of the Sydney Opera House; in the background: the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch; small sailboats
the yellow facade of Flinders Street Station with its green copper dome; in the background: a green tram
the Sky Tower above the harbor full of sailboats; in the background: green volcanic hills; a silver fern frond
deep blue Lake Wakatipu under jagged snowy mountains; in the background: a vintage steamship with a red funnel
the Diamond Head crater above Waikiki beach; in the background: colorful surfboards; red hibiscus flowers; palm trees
